decisions.reason: As a newly launched door lever handle family in the firm's core range, it fits the announced one-stop hardware strategy and recent launch investment makes withdrawal unlikely absent clear failure.
The mitred door lever handle family is close to the firm's established architectural design competence, so management is likely to justify and continue the 2023 launch rather than reverse it quickly.
A multifunctional door lever handle aligns especially well with barrier-free and system-solution positioning, strengthening commitment to keep it on the market despite its youth.
Although a more standard door lever handle may be somewhat easier to prune than a flagship line, it still sits squarely in the core business and recent commitment argues for retention.
This collection had a dedicated product page and a 2023 German Design Award, creating strong public commitment and reputational support for keeping it in the portfolio.
A finish option is easier to discontinue than a full product family, but the sunk development and marketing effort and its fit with premium architectural hardware still favor continuation.
